checks: relative PostgreSQL %p path resolved under PGDATA
WAL segment copied to archive directory with matching bytes
temporary archive file is atomically renamed and not left behind
path-like invalid segment name is rejected
production host archive path is required to be an absolute managed off-host path
limitations: This is a helper/configuration check, not a running PostgreSQL archive_mode or point-in-time recovery drill.
Production off-site storage, retention and restore-to-time validation remain deployment gates.
